title: The accent module repeats a template's later rival rules after its routes, so the template's cascade order holds
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A later same-weight rule of the same colour channel is written after its route verbatim; non-rivals are not; the look guard accepts only the verbatim rival.

tests: a later rule of the same weight that sets the same paint is repeated after the route, word for word
the look guard takes the repeated rules as the template writes them, and nothing else
